notes: Dead as Disco Demo (Steam 3763830, UE 5.7 custom branch). Mouse-driven menus, read from the desktop window (the Mopic display doubles the UI text). The very first start asks about Streamer Safe Mode (click OFF) before the main menu; a fresh install shows NEW GAME instead of CONTINUE. Route: CONTINUE > stage hub > Enter > FREE PLAY > first song (Maniac) > click again to play > play > Esc ends the song (RESULT) > Stage Select > Esc > EXIT GAME > EXIT GAME on the wishlist screen. Never click GET THE GAME!, GIVE FEEDBACK or SIGN UP (store/browser). With Native Stereo Fix active the desktop window shows the 3D scene behind the menus; checkpoints sit on opaque UI. A played song posts its score to the account's leaderboard.

steps.note: the HUD pulses with the beat and loses hearts, so there is no stable gameplay checkpoint; the RESULT screen after Esc proves a song was played

steps.keys: lmb lmb rmb w a s d
